exceptions.reason: The only rewrite destination hostname is the operator-controlled API_INTERNAL_URL; request input cannot select the destination host.
exceptions.mitigation: Production Compose fixes API_INTERNAL_URL to the internal API service.

exceptions.reason: PDF.js 3 is a legacy line and its supported-line upgrade is intentionally outside Release A.
exceptions.mitigation: The only getDocument path sets isEvalSupported=false; the release browser contract asserts that invariant.

exceptions.reason: tar 6 is reachable only through pdfjs-dist's optional canvas/node-pre-gyp dependency; forcing tar 7 across that API boundary is not a patch-safe change.
exceptions.mitigation: Release and local locked installs use --ignore-scripts, so node-pre-gyp and this tar parser are not executed; canvas is aliased out of the browser bundle.
